snapshotID.description: Opaque identity of revision, tracked content and graph inputs; independent of wall-clock and cache-hit telemetry.

report.description: Legacy report payload remains an array; schema version is selected by this schema document.

login.description: GitHub device sign-in result. Project access is requested only by an explicit projects capability start with an expected account; response fields stay unchanged.

overlap.description: Overlap risks between local worktrees since each common ancestor. Same paths and static dependency relationships are warnings, not proof of a textual merge conflict. Watch JSON emits one such object per changed snapshot (NDJSON).

move.description: Read-only file or directory move plan with remapped static references and evidence. Does not move files or guarantee textual import patches.

module.description: Static npm manifest and import audit of tracked working-tree files. Unobserved declarations and differing version specifications are review candidates, not automatic removal or compatibility decisions.

logo.description: Saved CLI trademark visibility. Defaults to true; environment overrides only affect rendering.
